changeSet.author: facilon
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS service_agents ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, authorized_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, agent_code VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE, agent_type VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'SERVICE_AGENT', full_name VARCHAR(200), email VARCHAR(200), mobile VARCHAR(50), assigned_region VARCHAR(100), assigned_segment VARCHAR(100), is_active TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1, onboarding_status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'APPROVED', tenant_id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_by VARCHAR(255), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, modified_by VARCHAR(255), modified_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT fk_sa_authorized_user FOREIGN KEY (authorized_user_id) REFERENCES authorized_user(authorized_user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, INDEX idx_sa_authorized_user (authorized_user_id), INDEX idx_sa_tenant (tenant_id) )

changeSet.author: facilon
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS investor_service_agent_delegations ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, investor_id BIGINT NOT NULL, service_agent_id BIGINT NOT NULL, scope VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, can_view_profile TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1, can_edit_kyc TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, can_upload_documents TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, can_submit_forms TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, valid_from DATE, valid_to DATE, is_active TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1, consent_version VARCHAR(20), notes TEXT, tenant_id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_by VARCHAR(255), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, modified_by VARCHAR(255), modified_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT fk_deleg_investor FOREIGN KEY (investor_id) REFERENCES investor(investor_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_deleg_service_agent FOREIGN KEY (service_agent_id) REFERENCES service_agents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, INDEX idx_deleg_investor (investor_id), INDEX idx_deleg_agent (service_agent_id), INDEX idx_deleg_active (is_active, valid_from, valid_to) )

changeSet.author: facilon
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS service_agent_audit_logs ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, service_agent_id BIGINT NOT NULL, investor_id BIGINT NOT NULL, delegation_id BIGINT, action_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, action_category VARCHAR(100), entity_type VARCHAR(100), entity_id VARCHAR(100), endpoint VARCHAR(500), http_method VARCHAR(10), success TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1, error_message TEXT, ip_address VARCHAR(50), user_agent TEXT, tenant_id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_by VARCHAR(255), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, modified_by VARCHAR(255), modified_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INDEX idx_audit_agent (service_agent_id), INDEX idx_audit_investor (investor_id), INDEX idx_audit_created (created_at) )

changeSet.sql: INSERT IGNORE INTO group_role (group_id, role_list_id) SELECT ug.group_id, rl.role_list_id FROM user_group ug, role_list rl WHERE ug.group_name = 'SERVICE_AGENT' AND rl.label = 'SERVICE_AGENT';

changeSet.sql: INSERT IGNORE INTO role_authority (role_list_id, authority_list_id) SELECT rl.role_list_id, al.authority_list_id FROM role_list rl, authority_list al WHERE rl.label = 'SERVICE_AGENT' AND al.authority_name IN ( 'SA_VIEW_INVESTORS', 'SA_VIEW_INVESTOR_PROFILE', 'SA_EDIT_INVESTOR_KYC', 'SA_UPLOAD_DOCUMENTS', 'SA_SUBMIT_FORMS', 'SA_MANAGE_DELEGATIONS', 'SA_VIEW_AUDIT' );

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE service_agents ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS service_provider_id BIGINT NULL, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS photo_url VARCHAR(500) NULL, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS pan_number VARCHAR(20) NULL, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS address_proof_url VARCHAR(500) NULL, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS registration_number VARCHAR(100) NULL, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS dv_service_agent_id VARCHAR(100) NULL, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS onboarded_at TIMESTAMP NULL, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS onboarded_by VARCHAR(200) NULL, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS deleted_at TIMESTAMP NULL;
